prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
start = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x142326a80")
end = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x142327280")

it = listing.getInstructions(start, True)
refmgr = prog.getReferenceManager()
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
insns = []
call_targets = {}
count = 0
while it.hasNext():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    ins = it.next()
    a = ins.getAddress()
    if a >= end:
        break
    mnem = ins.getMnemonicString()
    ops = []
    for i in range(ins.getNumOperands()):
        r = ins.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i)
        ops.append(r if r is not None else "")
    raw = ins.getBytes()
    hexb = "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in raw)
    insns.append([str(a), mnem, ops, hexb])
    count += 1
    if mnem == "CALL":
        for r in refmgr.getReferencesFrom(a):
            if r.getReferenceType().isCall():
                to = r.getToAddress()
                tgt = fm.getFunctionAt(to)
                nm = str(tgt.getName()) if tgt else str(to)
                call_targets.setdefault(nm, str(to))
out["name"] = "sim_wren_boids"
out["win"] = 0
out["range"] = ["0x142326a80", "0x142327280"]
out["insn_count"] = count
out["insns"] = insns

out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
start = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141d85d40")
end = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141d8605e")
listing = prog.getListing()
it = listing.getInstructions(start, True)
refmgr = prog.getReferenceManager()
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
insns = []
call_targets = {}
count = 0
while it.hasNext():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    ins = it.next()
    a = ins.getAddress()
    if a >= end:
        break
    mnem = ins.getMnemonicString()
    ops = []
    for i in range(ins.getNumOperands()):
        r = ins.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i)
        ops.append(r if r is not None else "")
    raw = ins.getBytes()
    hexb = "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in raw)
    insns.append([str(a), mnem, ops, hexb])
    count += 1
    if mnem == "CALL":
        for r in refmgr.getReferencesFrom(a):
            if r.getReferenceType().isCall():
                to = r.getToAddress()
                tgt = fm.getFunctionAt(to)
                nm = str(tgt.getName()) if tgt else str(to)
                call_targets.setdefault(nm, str(to))
out["name"] = "update_butterfly_states"
out["win"] = 2
out["range"] = ["0x141d85d40", "0x141d8605e"]
out["insn_count"] = count
out["insns"] = insns
out["call_targets"] = call_targets
print(json.dumps(out))
